final_resume.summary: Backend-focused developer with 6 months of hands-on experience building scalable REST services in Java and Spring Boot, demonstrating strong problem-solving ability and attention to code quality through rigorous testing and bug resolution.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Architected a full-stack e-commerce platform with Spring Boot backend and React frontend, integrating MySQL for transactional data and AWS S3 for image storage. Deployed on AWS EC2 with features including cart management, checkout workflow, and order history retrieval.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL, enabling seamless return processing.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module coverage from 45% to 70% and improving code reliability.
Debugged and resolved 12 production issues reported by the support team, demonstrating strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project in Python or JavaScript to match the JD's core language requirements; both are heavily used in Google Cloud services.
Study and practise system design concepts (scalability, load balancing, caching, microservices) through LeetCode or Grokking the System Design Interview; document a design in your portfolio.
Contribute to an open-source project on GitHub that uses GCP services (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore) to gain hands-on experience and demonstrate code review readiness.
Deepen your understanding of distributed systems fundamentals (consensus, replication, eventual consistency) and document learnings in a blog or GitHub README.
Build a second project incorporating NLP (e.g., sentiment analysis using a library like spaCy or NLTK) or UI/UX improvements to a React app to broaden your skill set.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid backend fundamentals, but the role requires 1+ year of professional experience and proficiency in multiple languages (Python, C++, JavaScript) and distributed systems concepts you have not yet demonstrated. Focus on gaining 1-2 years of professional experience and learning the missing languages and system design skills before applying.
